spec.scope: normal attacks only, NON-core hits only

ENGINE GAP: the sim treats core as a per-shot RATE, not discrete core/non-core hit events, so a literal non-core counter is inexpressible — the honest encoding is a blended EXP cadence ⚑: EXP/s = effShots/s × [(1−c)/6 + c/3] where c = core rate
spec.nearestWrongModel: hitCount:6 over ALL hits (core hits then feed BOTH tracks, double-counting EXP and shortening the ramp)
spec.distinguishingAssertion: EXP grant count over a window ≈ floor(nonCoreRounds/6) + floor(coreRounds/3) given the sim's core rate — NOT floor(allRounds/6) + floor(coreRounds/3); equivalently the ramp-to-100 time matches the blended formula, not the double-count one
spec.inertness: no EXP from skill/burst/DoT hits — normal-attack rounds only

All magnitudes are literal kit text (DATAMINED); the only ⚑ values are the EXP/level ramp trajectory and the DoT's level snapshot at first cast.
